verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is ElevenLabs' own single-use authentication token, which expires after 15 minutes and is offered as an alternative to the full API key. That limits credential lifetime and reuse, a narrow form of least privilege, but nothing shows permission-scoped keys or agent-specific credential issuance. Missing for 10: per-key permission/endpoint scoping, agent-oriented credential issuance docs, quota or rate limits per key, revocation management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A single-use authentication token... This token can only be used once and expires after 15 minutes. Alternative to API key or bearer token authentication for frontend clients.
